distinguishability.note: detectability_auc=max(raw_auroc, 1-raw_auroc): 0.5 means chance-level separation (good fidelity); 1.0 means trivially separable (poor fidelity).

evaluation_sampling.note: Rare-group fidelity, primary downstream models, and explicit outcome tasks use complete frames; memory-heavy diagnostics use the recorded whole-learner samples.

tail_fidelity.operational_note: Late failure and recovery are correctness-trajectory definitions. Dropout is emitted only when an explicit completion/non-participation outcome is supplied.

checks: active standard artifact hash matches generation metadata

excluded_from_publication.distinguishability: Detector includes independently postprocessed columns; excluded from model comparison.
excluded_from_publication.diversity_uniqueness_rates: Novelty is not monotonic quality; retained only in the raw diagnostic report.

omitted_standard_tail_groups.dropout: Synthetic dropout prevalence/shape is set by the common outcome postprocessor.
omitted_standard_tail_groups.late_failure: Rare-group prevalence is retained, but trajectory shape is not estimable because fewer than 10 real or synthetic tail learners are available.
omitted_standard_tail_groups.persistent_misconception: Weekly activity categories do not define a pedagogical misconception.
omitted_standard_tail_groups.rare_skill_path: Rare-group prevalence is retained, but trajectory shape is not estimable because fewer than 10 real or synthetic tail learners are available.
omitted_standard_tail_groups.recovery: Rare-group prevalence is retained, but trajectory shape is not estimable because fewer than 10 real or synthetic tail learners are available.

excluded_from_publication.raw_diagnostic_aggregates: Unfiltered all-column marginals/NMI, detector accuracy, and minimum-NN extremes are not table metrics.
excluded_from_publication.raw_test_fidelity_duplicates: Held-out real data is reserved for downstream generalization; primary fidelity is against real train.
excluded_from_publication.sequence_length_model_ranking: All generators use the same trajectory-length sampler, so length metrics are pipeline diagnostics.
excluded_from_publication.short_and_long_trajectory_tails: Shared length sampler prevents attribution to a generator architecture.

research_question_mapping.rq1: Average, temporal, dependence, subgroup, and rare-pathway preservation.

research_question.scope: Preservation of average learner behaviour and rare educational pathways by unmodified synthetic trajectory generators.
